description: WRITE. Create a Depot container-build project (an isolated build cache). Idempotent by name: if an active project with the same name exists, that project is returned. Defaults: cache 50 GB / 14 days, hardware HARDWARE_16X32 on AWS builders. Depot: ProjectService/CreateProject.

build_timeout_minutes.description: Max duration of each build, minutes. Omit for no timeout.

cache_keep_days.description: Days to keep cache entries since last use (1-30). Default 14.

cache_keep_gb.description: Max cache size per architecture, GB (25-1000). Default 50.

hardware.description: Builder size, e.g. HARDWARE_16X32 (16 CPU / 32 GB).

max_concurrent_builds.description: Builds per builder before autoscaling adds one. Omit to disable autoscaling.

organization_id.description: Owning organization. Only needed for user tokens that belong to more than one org.

region_id.description: Depot region or cloud connection, e.g. us-east-1 or eu-central-1.

name: depot_create_project
title: Create a project
